title: Browser surface
description: Presentation surface for a web address: the current page card (host, address, notes), the navigation trail, a zoom and a scroll position. It never loads the page (the frame has no network): the user opens it in a tab. The Tool Brain drives it with surface_open, surface_history, surface_scroll and surface_zoom.

history.description: Navigation trail, oldest first. The current page is history[index].

url.description: http(s) address; opened in a new tab on request.

index.description: Position of the current page in history.

zoom.description: Zoom of the page card, in percent.

scroll.description: Scroll position of the page card, in percent of its scrollable height.

body.description: Notes shown on the page card, markdown.

data.body: Les **pragmas** utiles pour la migration du stockage.
